mentions.name: hono-inertia
mentions.description: An adapter that integrates Inertia.js with the Hono web framework, aiming to become the best Inertia adapter for Hono and a strong way to do server-side rendering in Vue or other frontend frameworks, avoiding reliance on full-stack frameworks.
mentions.source_excerpt:
1. v4 of my Inertia.js adapter for the Hono framework – https://github.com/brachkow/hono-inertia/pull/6

I want to expand the thing I made to write Things To Have without relying on annoying "full-stack" frameworks, into:

- the best Inertia adapter for Hono

- the best way to do SSR in Vue (or whatever framework you use)
